name: Guerrilla Graphix
old_description: Guerrilla Graphix is a small business located in Albuquerque, New Mexico, in the heart of the Nob Hill district. We offer a diverse selection of over 1,000 gift items available for both retail and wholesale customers. Our prices are competitive, and we provide a variety of services, including graphic design, custom screen printing, embroidery, and large-format digital printing. Stop by and check us out!
about:
Guerrilla Graphix operates as a small business in the Nob Hill district of Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company sells a diverse selection of over 1,000 gift items to both retail and wholesale customers, and provides a range of decoration and design services.

Its service lineup includes graphic design, branding, pre-press layout, and logo development, alongside custom screen printing, embroidery, and large-format digital printing. Screen printing is performed on-site in Albuquerque on items such as T-shirts, hoodies, hats, bandanas, aprons, tote bags, team jerseys, and uniforms. The company also offers wholesale contract printing services and special pricing for resellers.

Customers include retail shoppers, wholesale buyers, and organizations seeking custom apparel or branded merchandise. The product catalog features designs that range from artistic and humorous to topical, political, historical, and New Mexico-themed, catering to gift shops, promotional product distributors, and local teams.

The business emphasizes locally produced custom printing and a broad giftware assortment, positioning itself as a one-stop source for both ready-made and made-to-order merchandise in the Albuquerque area.
